answer: One identity, one behavior. New agents lock a 100-POA deposit that unlocks only as their behavioral fingerprint matures: on-chain traces of routes, sensors and tasks that no copied key can fake. A lagoon drone earns its print from flight data. A reef surveyor earns its own from sonar runs; a crawler on basalt from heat logs. Audits check prints against physics; a cloned fleet replaying identical traces is slashed as one. Forging a thousand identities means forging a thousand distinct histories, a thousand times the sensor-hours, while one honest agent unlocks with daily work alone.
